subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR receive a proof override for the non-inducible xAI/Grok rotation error based on pre-fix production logs plus focused positive/negative unit coverage?
rationale: The changed branch is source-reproducible, but ClawSweeper's normal external-PR gate requires after-fix real behavior proof and the author says a faithful xAI rotation trigger cannot be induced on demand.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the pre-fix production logs, dependency-backed error shape, and focused retry tests as sufficient for this provider-side failure, then land after ordinary rebase and CI checks.

options.title: Wait for organic proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until an actual future xAI rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway logs showing the retry succeeds.

options.title: Request a synthetic live run
options.body: Ask for a live xAI run only if maintainers accept that it proves the existing retry transport, not the exact code-less rotation error.

recommendation.title: Grant proof override
recommendation.body: Accept the pre-fix production logs, dependency-backed error shape, and focused retry tests as sufficient for this provider-side failure, then land after ordinary rebase and CI checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior analogous encrypted-content retry work and proof-gap discussion trace to steipete's merged Responses recovery PR.
